items.title: Security and Privacy Implications of Large Language Models in Augmented Reality Applications
items.desc: Survey and empirical study on XR privacy risks and user security awareness regarding LLMs/VLMs integrated into AR applications.

items.title: Dietary Classification from PPG and Accelerometer Signals Using Smart Earring Wearables

items.title: Architectural Modifications to Foundation Models for Long-Horizon Robotic Task Planning
